children: Pipes and tubes maker APL Apollo Tubes Ltd on Friday (November 27) said the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has extended the deadline for Tata Steel Ltd's open offer to acquire up to a 26% stake in the company to December 8 from December 1.

In a regulatory filing, the company said Kotak Mahindra Capital Company Ltd, the manager of the open offer, had received approval from SEBI through an email dated November 27, following a request from Tata Steel.
The open offer is for the acquisition of up to 7.28 crore fully paid-up equity shares of APL Apollo, representing 26% of its expanded voting share capital. Each share has a face value of ₹2.
Tata Steel issued the public announcement for the open offer on November 23, 2026. The deadline for filing the draft letter of offer with SEBI remains unchanged at December 8, 2026.

This comes after Tata Steel last said it had executed an agreement to acquire the entire 26.6% promoter stake in APL Apollo Tubes Ltd for ₹15,510 crore and plans to take over another 26% in the pipes and tubes maker through an open offer of ₹16,756 crore.
The deal will enable Tata Steel to expand steel tubes and colour-coated products output to 7.5 million tonnes per annum, from 2.5 MTPA at present.

Tata Steel looks to complete all transactions related to the APL Apollo Tubes deal within the current financial year, according to a company statement. The transactions remain subject to necessary approvals.

Amid concerns over the deal, Tata Steel indicated revisiting the structure of the proposed acquisition. "We have taken cognisance of the feedback received and are carefully examining the concerns raised to determine how best to address them," a Tata Steel spokesperson stated.
The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is yet to receive the revised contours of the transaction, and the regulator would await the revised proposal before taking further steps.
Under the takeover regulations, the draft letter of offer is generally required to be filed within five working days of the public announcement.
Shares of APL Apollo Tubes Ltd ended at ₹1,505.10, up by ₹24.10, or 1.63%, on the BSE.

title: SEBI extends deadline for Tata Steel's 26% open offer statement in APL Apollo to December 8
